that document records historical provenance rather than current execution.

Later bound predecessor `5cb87130bc8f9f4d2ef4980b08ae5f7090b15590` images were
compiled and exercised in bounded partial diagnostics. Those receipts do not
accept all14 tests, the32MiB targets, or the separate feature-routing successor.
The routing and companion proposals have source checks; their successor

The successor adds a test-only Cargo feature route. Production logic, public

The test module uses a protected synthetic v1 owner, a real asserted schema

The requested128/256/384KiB single-echo cases retain all earlier guards. A

Named EARLY_GATE/OTHER_GATE failures mean crossing was not established. Only

## Proposed explicit diagnostic route (requires owner admission)

The six small regression tests remain ordinary software checks. The eight
capacity diagnostics are selected by the explicit `capacity-d-diagnostics`
feature. This routing preserves all14 test functions, assertions, worker guards,
fixtures and unresolved obligations. A six-test PASS does not accept capacity.
An all-features run deliberately selects diagnostics and needs its own bounded
resource window. No test is ignored, skipped at runtime, or converted to
generic-error success.

Compile the test image using the selected owner Rust/profile and isolated Cargo
target, with native guards and fresh resource admission. The explicit command is
`cargo test -p tos-command --lib --features capacity-d-diagnostics --no-run`.
Then run each exact libtest selector separately with `--exact --nocapture
--test-threads=1` under the admitted operator deadline. The ordinary workspace
feature list does not enable `capacity-d-diagnostics`. Do not reuse D experimental
O3 as the accepted owner profile without its owner's choice.

Diagnostic selectors (prefix each with
`source_native_cli::private_assessment::capacity_d_r4::`):

- `d_r4_precharged_scalar_quota_control`
- `d_r4_echo_128k_never_commits_unreadable_head`
- `d_r4_echo_256k_never_commits_unreadable_head`
- `d_r4_echo_384k_never_commits_unreadable_head`
- `d_r4_echo_480k_twice_never_commits_unreadable_head`
- `d_r4_producer_history_32mib_minus_one`
- `d_r4_producer_history_32mib_exact`
- `d_r4_producer_history_32mib_plus_one_never_breaks_reopen`

The four echo-shape obligations and three exact byte targets require separate
receipts. For exact32MiB−1/exact/+1, retain real producer prefix/checkpoints, exact
raw membership bytes, refusal classification, unchanged state and fresh cold
reopen. Earlier CPU/receipt/record/operator limits remain partial outcomes, never
byte-boundary PASS. The1023/1024/1025 input fixture separately records its seed
and early refusal; it does not prove1024 committed history events.

This feature route must be accepted together with an owned diagnostic schedule
and bounded command/receipt handoff. Pending diagnostic results remain visible
release obligations. Canonical ordinary software validation alone cannot close
the D package.


## Natural echo frontier and separate quota control

The fixed128/256/384KiB single-echo producer layouts cannot reach32MiB with
the unchanged128-receipt worker. One append over n committed batches uses
3n+9 schema checks: n39 needs126; n40 attempts129. The natural tests keep
the complete producer loop and require40 genuinely committed batches, exact
head/membership preservation, and a fresh40/40 cold reopen at this frontier.
Only an observed scalar `BudgetCheck("Cut scalar receipt count",129,128)`
at the final prepare check, with128 actual completed receipts and positive
other byte headroom, accepts that natural receipt frontier. It does not
accept the32MiB ceiling. Earlier CPU, deadline, protocol, byte or generic
refusals still fail or leave the bounded run incomplete. The recorded
source-only-v1 byte-crossing goal remains historical. This proposal would
supersede it for these three fixed layouts only after explicit owner acceptance;
the goal change and a runtime window have not been granted.

A cfg(test), fully delegating observer records the original typed worker
refusal before the existing prepare API maps it to
`Invalid("assessment batch schema execution")`. The generic mapped reason
alone cannot accept quota provenance. Production error mapping, guards,
worker/profile identity, and all source/publication fences remain unchanged.

`d_r4_precharged_scalar_quota_control` is a separate fourteenth test, not a
replacement for any natural-history test. It performs117 actual cheap schema
checks on the same real worker before the real n1/one-echo append; then it
requires the exact attempted129/completed128 scalar refusal, unchanged
snapshot, and fresh1/1 cold reopen. It is labelled PRECHARGED_QUOTA_CONTROL
and establishes neither natural40-history cost nor a32MiB boundary.

Verdicts are selected by the exact four entrypoint/layout mappings. The three
small single-echo selectors enter only the typed natural-quota branch; an early
byte-budget refusal cannot return success for them. The480KiB/two-echo selector
enters only the prepare/publish byte-budget branch; quota or generic refusal
cannot return success for it. Unknown layouts fail closed.

The480KiB/two-echo natural byte-crossing goal and the three real terminal
32MiB-minus/exact/plus assertions remain unchanged. The new proposal needs
its own matching diagnostic build, actual14-name selection and individually
classified outcomes. No source/fmt check here claims execution acceptance.
